text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is showing signs of fatigue,
so I take
her to rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I'm going to take a nap. See you
later.
Hey, get up already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch! ...What do you want?! Don't just go
around
waking people up when they're
sleeping!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wait... There's no one here. Where am
I?!

I don't want to startle you, but look
down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What?! My shadow is moving?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, bod. I'll cut right to the chase. How
about a
little competition, you and me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
If I win, I get my freedom. If you win, I
go back to
being a good little shadow...
Whaddya say?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you talk pretty big for a shadow...
Fine, I'll
take you on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! Now be a good shadow and
follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the true meaning of
jumping at your
own shadow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Behold the true power of the body!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text: Well... color me impressed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Okay. As promised, I'll go back to the
way I was.
It was fun while it lasted,
though. Let's run again
sometime.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're always running with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. I suppose so. Well then, keep it
up. I'm
expecting more good runs to
come.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... There's plenty more where that
came from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the refreshing dream, Narita
Brian
seems well-rested.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wh-why can't I catch up?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I win. Then, I'll be taking my
leave, as
agreed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: W-wait!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
If you want me to wait, you better catch
up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My shadow's here, but... Damn! How did
I lose to
my own shadow?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the strange dream has
prevented Narita
Brian from getting a
proper rest.
